rules: Write formal Bahasa Melayu for a general-to-intermediate market reader; prefer active, direct clauses.
Keep the source claim order unless a different order leaves every relationship explicit.
Use jika for an unfulfilled condition and selepas/ketika only where the source condition is already fulfilled.
Use boleh or mungkin only when they match the source's non-certain modality; never use pasti to smooth the prose.
Retain protected literals byte-for-byte in the localized article; presentation formatting is outside this pack.
Do not add causal connectors such as oleh itu or menyebabkan merely to join sentences.
